profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer
profile.summary: Engineering professional with a MS in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Carnegie Mellon and a BS in Computer Engineering from Milwaukee School of Engineering. Focused in embedded systems and medical devices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
C++ developer for autonomous pharmaceutical compounding system.

Writing and reviewing design documents, writing code and tests, performing code reviews, troubleshooting issues, determining root cause and coming up with fix, executing tests on hardware, collaborating with mechanical engineering and web app teams to fix and improve product, working with vendors, contributing to process improvement, mentoring junior developers, and tracking work in project management tools.
Technologies used: C++, lua, git, Visual Studio Code, Azure Dev Ops, Jira, Confluence, Windchill, Agile, PuTTY, and Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Contractor for the following companies: 
Philips: Developer for portable ventilator (May - Aug 2019)
Philips: Test for portable ventilator (Aug - Sept 2019)
Hitachi: Developer for trains (Sept 2019 - Jan 2020)
Philips: Developer for portable oxygen concentrator (Jan - May 2020)
Philips: Test for portable ventilator (May - Aug 2020)
Omnicell: Developer for autonomous pharmaceutical compounding system (Sept 2020 - Oct 2021)

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Held weekly recitations and office hours. Graded labs, homework, and exams.

positions.title: Development Tool Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Learning about cloud computing and DevOps.
Writing python scripts to gather metrics about the tools we support.

volunteerExperiences.description: I was on a team that set up and ran a three-day free clinic for people in Alauca, Honduras.
Participated in Hour of Code at Rufus King Middle School.

projects.title: Senior Design
projects.description: Rowing Monitoring Device: Worked on a team of five to design an immediate feedback system sewn into a wetsuit worn by a rower. The system calculates the force curve and analyzes the quality of every stroke which is then displayed to the rower and the coach.

projects.title: Networking 1
projects.description: In this class I worked on a team of three to develop a node that can exchange messages with other teams. We wrote in C on a PSOC 5LP. The project was fairly open ended but we had to follow the protocols listed in the interface standard.

organizations.name: Garfield Community Farm
organizations.description:
Help with daily chores: 
Watering plants, providing food and water for rabbit, goats, and chickens, and cleaning chicken coop

Helping with various projects:
Moving dirt to garden beds, weeding, cleaning the streets, clearing vines off fences. etc
